dish.title: Spaghetti Puttanesca
dish.description: Spaghetti tossed in a quick, punchy tomato sauce built on olive oil-melted anchovies, garlic, and chile flakes, with Kalamata olives and capers, finished with parsley and a last splash of olive oil. Egg-free dried pasta; no cheese, no butter.

recipe_version.title: Spaghetti Puttanesca
recipe_version.description: Spaghetti tossed in a quick, punchy tomato sauce built on olive oil-melted anchovies, garlic, and chile flakes, with Kalamata olives and capers, finished with parsley and a last splash of olive oil. Egg-free dried pasta; no cheese, no butter.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: for the pasta water only (4 quarts). Do not salt the sauce until the final taste; anchovies, olives, and capers season it.

ingredients.name: spaghetti
ingredients.note: REQUIRED egg-free dried pasta: label lists durum wheat semolina (plus water and standard enrichment) only. Not fresh egg pasta. Wheat allergen.

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp to build the sauce, 1 tbsp to finish.

ingredients.name: anchovy fillets
ingredients.note: about half of a 2-oz tin. Finfish allergen. They melt into the sauce and are the backbone of the flavor.

ingredients.name: flat-leaf parsley
ingredients.note: from about 1 small bunch; reserve 1 tbsp for the top

steps.title: Start the water and prep
steps.body: Fill a large pot with 4 quarts water, add the 2 tbsp kosher salt, cover, and set over high heat. It takes about 12 minutes to boil, which overlaps this prep and the anchovy step. Thinly slice the garlic. Drain and finely chop the anchovies. Roughly chop the olives. Rinse and drain the capers. Crush the tomatoes by hand in a bowl, keeping every bit of juice. Chop the parsley. HARD CONTRACT: egg-free dried spaghetti; no Parmesan, pecorino, butter, or cream anywhere in this dish.

steps.title: Melt the anchovies with garlic and chile
steps.body: In a 12-inch skillet over medium heat, warm 3 tbsp olive oil. Add the anchovies, garlic, and red pepper flakes. Cook, stirring and pressing the anchovies with a wooden spoon, until they dissolve into the oil and the garlic is pale gold at the edges, about 3 minutes. Do not let the garlic go dark brown. Stir in the tomato paste and cook 1 minute, until it darkens slightly.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.body: Add the crushed tomatoes and their juice, the olives, capers, and oregano. Bring to a brisk simmer over medium-high, then adjust the heat to keep it bubbling steadily. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is thick and glossy and the oil begins to pool at the edges, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.body: As soon as the sauce reaches its simmer (the water is at a rolling boil by now), add the spaghetti to the pot. Stir during the first minute so it does not stick. Cook until 1 minute shy of package al dente, about 8 to 9 minutes. Scoop out 1 cup of pasta water, then drain.

steps.title: Toss and finish
steps.body: Add the drained spaghetti and 1/2 cup reserved pasta water to the sauce. Toss with tongs over medium-high heat until the sauce clings to every strand and looks glossy, 1 to 2 minutes; add more pasta water a splash at a time if it tightens. Off heat, toss in most of the parsley, the black pepper, and the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil. Taste and add a pinch of salt only if needed. Serve in shallow bowls topped with the reserved parsley. No cheese, no butter.

recipe_version.heat: High heat for the pasta water; medium for the anchovy-garlic bloom; brisk simmer (medium to medium-high) for the sauce; medium-high to toss. No oven.
